name: streamrecord-oneaquahealth-snapshot
title: StreamRecord: OneAquaHealth site and health-risk snapshot
description: Frozen snapshot of the ENORA OneAquaHealth research sites and lab health-risk scores, plus verified quotes from OneAquaHealth publications, as used by StreamRecord. Not affiliated with OneAquaHealth.

sources.title: ENORA OneAquaHealth API (sites/all and resilience-map/health-risks)
sources.note: Joined on sites[].code == healthRisks[].researchSiteCode; raw snapshots and sha256 in data/snapshots/

fields.name: site_name
fields.description: Site name as published by ENORA. Empty for T21 and T24, which ENORA publishes without a name (the app shows them as "Site T21" and "Site T24")

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, derived from the city (not in the API)

fields.name: health_risk_score
fields.description: ENORA healthRiskScore, 0 to 1; mean of the three scaled parts; empty when not published

fields.name: band_ours
fields.description: StreamRecord's own tertile of the 96 scores (cut points 0.2269 and 0.3491); NOT an official OneAquaHealth rating
